Microsoft reported another solid result for F2Q, but it ultimately fell short of more 
lofty market expectations, in particular for Azure growth. While most investors 
continue to hone in on this as the most important KPI, mgmt. again made it clear 
Azure is bearing the brunt of current supply constraints as they prioritize GPU 
allocation in support of AI usage in first-party apps and R&D to accelerate product 
innovation in pursuit of higher margin, recurring software opportunities up the 
stack. So while Azure growth still came in 1pt above guidance at +38% y/y @CC, 
this was shy of what we believe was a buyside bogey of >39%+ and what mgmt. 
indicated would have been >40% had they allocated all incremental GPU capacity 
in F1H26 to Azure. Importantly, we'd highlight Azure is still growing well above the 
market, guided to sustain 37-38% growth in F3Q and we believe can likely persist 
near here for several more quarters off a higher base.
From a margin and LTV perspective we believe the application layer has and is still 
generally perceived as highly strategic ground on which Microsoft has incumbent 
advantages. But we'd argue it is also the last area to see tangible benefits as AI 
monetization works its way up the stack, and is more than ever viewed as at risk of 
disruption and/or devaluation, which is weighing on sentiment. That story has yet 
to play out in our view, so while foregoing Azure revenue now for high-margin 
application and consumer SW opportunity ahead seems a sensible long-term 
strategy, it puts the onus on Microsoft to deliver before it will get credit. We continue 
to see more evidence of steadily growing traction, including new disclosure this 
quarter of 15m paid M365 Copilot seats (accelerating q/q and +160% y/y), paid 
GitHub Copilot subs now up to 4.7m (+75% y/y) and >100k medical providers using 
Dragon Copi

Agentic Adoption Hinges on Security; E7 SKU Presents 
$100B Upsell Opportunity
Overweight
Price Target: $615.00
  
Our Call
Leveraging its signif E3 + E5 installed base, MSFT's new E7 SKU + merchandising muscle 
could prove a catalyst for broader M365 Copilot & Agent 365 adoption into C2H26. We est 
325M seats addressable, inc. 150M M365E3/E5 or $100B potential upsell opp.
 
Initial Thoughts
Agent 365, E7 'Frontier Suite' SKU, and Copilot Wave 3: MSFT this morning announced 
a trio of M365 advancements:
1. Agent 365 announced at $15 per user per month, a control plane for managing 
agents. New SKU will be generally available on May 1, 2026.
2. New E7 SKU announced at $99 per user per month, incl M365 E5, Entra Suite, 
Agent 365, and M365 Copilot. New SKU will be generally available on May 1, 2026.
3. M365 Copilot Wave 3 released, built in "close collaboration" with Anthropic's Cowork.
 
 
Expect E7 bundle upsells drive M365 Copilot, Agent 365 adoption; price hikes timely:
New Agent 365 offer brings agent registry/agent ID (in Entra), observability, risk signals, 
etc.—all important prerequisites for agentic adoption. Similar to M365 Copilot, see Agent 
365 adoption as unlikely standalone (via $30/mo, $15/mo SKUs) and instead expect 
both see accelerated adoption via E7 SKU. Note: recent M365 price hikes already force 
enterprise negotiations in 2H26, creating NT adoption catalyst.
 
Quantifying E7 opp: est ~325M enterprise seats, incl ~150M E3/E5 seats; est E7 = 
$100B annual upsell opp: See existing E3/E5 seats as highest propensity to adopt E7. 
Recall MSFT rolled out M365 E3/E5 suites on Aug 1, 2017, disclosed ~45M E5 seats / 
12% of installed base by Jun 30, 2022, and disclosed 160M seats across "premium" SKUs
Sep 21, 2023. Our SKU mapping suggests MSFT now at ~150M seats across E3/E5; 
uplift across E3/E5 = $96B annually. See our prior SKU ests as of Jul 2023 and Jun 2025.

Azure 供應受限時，Microsoft 點解仲有力推 E7 加價式 upsell？

text:
當Azure供應受限時，Microsoft力推E7加價式upsell可能基於以下原因：  
1. **優先GPU資源分配**：面對供應約束，公司優先將GPU分配給第一方應用程序的AI使用和R&D，以加速產品創新並追求更高利潤的重複軟件收入，因此Azure增長雖高但未達預期【KB:20260205_Deutsche_Bank_MSFT_Microsoft-_F2Q_L】。  
2. **AI驅動的軟件層戰略**：軟件層（如M365 Copilot、GitHub Copilot等）被視為具有戰略優勢，但AI貨幣化需逐步向上游傳導。E7 SKU整合了多項AI相關功能（如Agent 365、M365 Copilot），可藉此推廣AI產品，從而在Azure供應受限時尋求新的增長點【KB:20260205_Deutsche_Bank_MSFT_Microsoft-_F2Q_L, 20260316_Wells_Fargo_MSFT_MSFT-_Agentic_Adop】。  
3. **上調價格的時機合適**：2025年下半年企業將面臨M365價格上調，這可能成為NT（新技術）採用的催化劑，而E7 SKU的加價式銷售可在價格上調前推廣，從而抓住這一機遇【KB:20260316_Wells_Fargo_MSFT_MSFT-_Agentic_Adop】。  
4. **Addressable Market龐大**：E7 SKU的目標用戶群（約3.25億企業用戶，其中1.5億為E3/E5用戶）龐大，預計帶來1000億美元的年度銷售額，這一潛力可彌補Azure供應受限帶來的影響【KB:20260316_Wells_Fargo_MSFT_MSFT-_Agentic_Adop】。
